items.q: In word, how do I use View?
items.answer:
To use View in Word, follow these steps:

1. Look at the screen [3].
2. Move your pointer to the View tab on the Ribbon [3].
3. Click on the View tab to reveal additional options [3].

results.task: open word, type 'The Binomial Theorem' in the center of the page, apply 'Bodoni MT Poster Compressed' font, and save as 'Binomial_Theorem.docx' in D:\new_automation\data\practice\word

open word, type 'A Fourier Series Example' and add a 2x5 table with the numbers 1 to 10 in the first row and their squares in the second row, apply 'Avenir Next LT Pro' font, and save as 'Fourier_Series.docx' in D:\new_automation\data\practice\word
open word, type 'Garamond' in the center, add a 5x5 table with the numbers 1 to 25, apply 'Goudy Stout' font, and save as 'Garamond_Table.docx' in D:\new_automation\data\practice\word
open word, type 'Jokerman' in the center, add a 'Letter' layout, apply 'MS Reference Sans Serif' font, and save as 'Jokerman_Letter.docx' in D:\new_automation\data\practice\word

open word, type 'The Expansion of a Sum' in the center, add a '2x5 Table' with the numbers 1 to 10 in the first row and their sum in the second row, apply 'Cascadia Mono SemiBold' font, and save as 'Expansion_Sum.docx' in D:\new_automation\data\practice\word
